title: nbn service disruption - Albury, NSW
current_summary:
The affected nbn services in Albury, NSW were restored at about 1:15 am AEDT on 13 October 2026, and the incident was closed at 1:20 am AEDT.

Resolution: nbn reconfigured network to restore service

Services in your area have been restored following an unexpected network issue. If your service has not reconnected automatically, try restarting your Wi-Fi router and nbn Connection Box (if you have one).

updates.content:
This affects some nbn services in Albury, NSW. The issue was logged at 4:55 pm AEDT on 12 October 2026, and no restoration estimate has been provided yet.

nbn is working hard to resolve an unexpected network issue in your area causing a partial or total loss of connectivity to your nbn service. Using mobile data can help you stay connected if needed.
nbn has confirmed that services affected in Albury, NSW have been restored and the incident is now closed.
